M1.reason: In all ten views the outline reads as a standing man in balaclava, vest, cargo trousers and boots, with no part sticking out or missing. The arms hang at the sides or sit at the hips, and the outline matches the brief's words.

M2.reason: Measured 23.7 x 22 x 69.4 against a requested height of 69 (0.6% off). Width and depth are within 15% of a human's, so all three are within the 15% band.

M3.reason: Brief parts checked one by one: black balaclava with face opening (front, back); vest (front, sides, back); vest pouches on the chest, a painted-looking row with a clear pouch form at game size (front, front-right); belt gear pouches on both hips with strap detail (left, right); cargo trousers with thigh pockets (left, right, front-left); boots (every view). None missing, and the chest pouches read at game size.

M4.reason: Balaclava and vest are black, trousers grey-white camouflage, boots dark leather, skin on hands and forearms. The brief names only black balaclava, vest and boots, and each is the colour it asks. The camouflage and fingerless gloves add to the brief without contradicting it.

M5.reason: Surface detail is a yellow lettering on the vest's back and small gold markings on the chest panel, plus forearm tattoos and camouflage pattern. The brief asks for none of these, but they sit in plausible places and add nothing that reads as wrong at game size.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 here. The line-up test is measured apart. The asset passed in all four readings (picked B, C, D, B against the asset at A, B, C, A), so the cap is met.

M7.reason: Front faces forward in the front view. The figure stands upright on both feet at the floor line in the side and front-left views, and the run and dive frames start from that floor line.

M8.reason: SMAK checkErrors is empty. 873 triangles, under the median of 1733 for Half-Life's own of its kind and size. No open or floating faces show in any view, and the underside view is not something a player sees.

C1.reason: Run (30 frames, floor line): arms pump, legs swing, boots stay attached in every frame. Attack (shoot_onehanded, 20 frames): the torso leans and the gun arm stays with the body. Stunt (dive_f_akimbo, 22 frames): the body goes flat with legs trailing, no part comes apart or floats. No original motion is in these pictures to compare the timing against, so this is judged on the faults visible.

C2.reason: Measured as keeping the mod's shared contract (every stock animation at its number, shared bones, attachments and bodyparts). The measurement reports no fault, and nothing in the motion pictures suggests a broken bone or attachment.
